ticket_text: Add a way for sellers to mark a listing as sold so it stops showing up in search, but it should still show up when searching with no status filter at all.
problem: Need sold status to hide from search but visible without filter.
acceptance_criteria: Sold listings are excluded when status filter is applied.
Sold listings appear when no status filter is used.
Status change persists after editing the listing.
edge_cases: Listing marked sold still appears in category-only search without status filter.
Attempting to mark an already sold listing should return no error.
test_cases: Search with status=available excludes sold listings.
Search with no status filter includes sold listings.
